data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that scrolls text infinitely.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter widget that scrolls text infinitely with various customizations such as custom scroll directions, durations, curves, and pauses after every round.
use_when: You need to display a long text string in a restricted horizontal or vertical space using a continuous scrolling marquee effect.
You want customized scrolling animations, pauses, velocities, or fading edges for text.
avoid_when: You need to scroll generic non-text children or complex widget trees instead of plain text.
You need standard multi-line static text or simple wrapping layouts.
strengths: Supports infinite text scrolling with numerous customizable options (velocity, pause after rounds, acceleration/deceleration).
Easy to set up and use with minimal configuration.
Built-in support for fading edges and right-to-left languages.
weaknesses: Strictly limited to text rather than arbitrary widget children.
Not intended for general layout scrolling or standard list views.
